calls_status.context: Telephony gateway, tunnel supervisor and calls.* settings; telephony secrets reported as configured/verified/source only

calls_status.response: Origin ACK with status only; secret values and pydantic details are never echoed

calendar_status.context: Owner's Google Calendar connection: secret presence only, the connected email from protected storage and calendar.* settings
calendar_status.effects: Read status: connected, email, calendar (primary), setup_needed, connecting, switches {read_events, share_free_busy, add_events}, last_error {code, message} | null. No network
calendar_status.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible
calendar_status.response: Origin ACK with status only; never a token, code or client secret; pydantic details never echoed

calendar_connect.context: The owner's OAuth client (google_oauth_client_id / google_oauth_client_secret secrets); refused with setup_needed when missing
calendar_connect.effects: Cancels any pending sign-in; starts a one-shot 127.0.0.1 listener on a random free port (never 8000); returns the Google auth URL (calendar.events + openid email, PKCE S256, random state, access_type=offline, prompt=consent). On the single matching callback: code exchange at oauth2.googleapis.com, one Calendar check, refresh token to the internal encrypted secret, email to protected storage, access token in memory
calendar_connect.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; the renderer opens only https://accounts.google.com URLs through the https-only electronAPI.openExternal
calendar_connect.response: Origin ACK {auth_url, calendar}; the outcome arrives as calendar_status to the owner's renderers; errors are fixed plain messages
calendar_connect.lifetime: Listener accepts exactly one callback with a matching state within 5 minutes, then stops; calendar_cancel, a new connect or process exit ends it

calendar_cancel.context: The pending Google sign-in, if any
calendar_cancel.effects: Stops the loopback listener and the pending sign-in; never touches a stored connection
calendar_cancel.response: Origin ACK with status; calendar_status to the owner's renderers

calendar_disconnect.context: The stored refresh token and connected email
calendar_disconnect.effects: Cancels a pending sign-in; revokes the token at oauth2.googleapis.com/revoke where possible; deletes the refresh token, the email and the in-memory access token
calendar_disconnect.response: Origin ACK {revoked, calendar}; a failed revoke is reported as last_error revoke_failed after local deletion

calendar_settings.schema: CalendarSettings (read_events, share_free_busy, add_events: bool; at least one; extra fields forbidden)
calendar_settings.effects: Persist the switches through SettingsService; they act only while connected
calendar_settings.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; same validation as update_settings {calendar}
calendar_settings.response: Origin ACK with status; settings snapshot and calendar_status to the owner's renderers

weather_home_set.schema: HomePlaceRequest (place: str 1-120 chars or null; extra fields forbidden)

weather_home_set.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible; same validation as update_settings {assistant: {home_place}}
weather_home_set.response: Origin ACK {ok, home_place}; not_found, weather_unavailable and invalid_arguments as plain messages; settings snapshot to the owner's renderers
weather_home_set.lifetime: One bounded request (6 s, redirects off, 9 s overall) and a synchronous settings save

facts_list.schema: FactsListRequest (kind: profile|preference|person|place|routine|episode or null; extra fields forbidden)
facts_list.context: The core database's memory_facts table (subject and text DPAPI-encrypted) and its keyed-hash FTS5 index; the memory pause switch
facts_list.effects: Read only: decrypts the current (not superseded, not expired) facts, newest first
facts_list.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible; fact text never logged
facts_list.response: Origin ACK {ok: true, paused, facts: [{id, kind, subject, text, confidence, pinned, sensitivity, source_conversation_id, source_turn, created_at, updated_at, valid_from, valid_to, superseded_by}]}; invalid_arguments and memory_unavailable as plain messages

facts_update.schema: FactsUpdateRequest (id: UUID; text 1-1000, subject 1-120, kind, pinned: bool, each optional, at least one; extra fields forbidden)
facts_update.context: The core database's memory_facts table (subject and text DPAPI-encrypted) and its keyed-hash FTS5 index; the memory pause switch
facts_update.effects: Edits one fact in place (same id, updated_at set) and rewrites its index entry in the same transaction. Owner edits are allowed while memory is paused; secret-like text is refused
facts_update.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible; fact text never logged
facts_update.response: Origin ACK {ok: true, fact}; memory_not_found, memory_secret, invalid_arguments and memory_unavailable as plain messages

facts_delete.context: The core database's memory_facts table (subject and text DPAPI-encrypted) and its keyed-hash FTS5 index; the memory pause switch
facts_delete.effects: Hard delete of one fact and its index entry in one transaction (encrypted SQLite/WAL pages are not forensically erased)
facts_delete.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible; fact text never logged
facts_delete.response: Origin ACK {ok: true, deleted: id}; memory_not_found, invalid_arguments and memory_unavailable as plain messages

facts_pause.context: The core database's memory_facts table (subject and text DPAPI-encrypted) and its keyed-hash FTS5 index; the memory pause switch
facts_pause.effects: Saves the pause switch (DPAPI-protected document memory_facts_state). Paused: memory_remember and automatic extraction write nothing; owner edits and deletes still work
facts_pause.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible; fact text never logged
facts_pause.response: Origin ACK {ok: true, paused}; invalid_arguments and memory_unavailable as plain messages

facts_export.context: The core database's memory_facts table (subject and text DPAPI-encrypted) and its keyed-hash FTS5 index; the memory pause switch
facts_export.effects: Read only: every fact, current and superseded, decrypted into JSON text {format: jarvis-memory, version: 1, exported_at, paused, facts}. Nothing is written to disk by the core
facts_export.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible; fact text never logged
facts_export.response: Origin ACK {ok: true, count, json}; memory_unavailable as a plain message. The JSON is private plaintext for the owner

vitals_watch.effects: on: adds this socket as a watcher and starts the vitals loop (psutil every 2 s, 5 s on low battery: the hint or this PC discharging at 20% or less). off: removes it; the loop stops when nobody watches. No settings, no files, no network
vitals_watch.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible; values never logged
vitals_watch.response: Origin ACK {ok, watching, paused, interval}; invalid_arguments as a plain message. Samples arrive as vitals {t, cpu, mem: {used, total}, disk: {used, total}, net: {up, down}, battery?: {percent, plugged}, gpu?: {percent}} to watching owner renderers only
vitals_watch.lifetime: Watch held until off, disconnect or shutdown; no sampling in gaming mode

agenda_next.lifetime: One bounded read (calendar 4 s); the rail asks every minute while visible

home_status.effects: Read status: connected, url, host, insecure (http), devices, rooms, grouped_by (area|domain), legacy_token_ignored, last_error {code, message} | null. No network
home_status.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible
home_status.response: Origin ACK {home}; never the token; pydantic details never echoed

home_connect.schema: HomeConnect (url, token: str; extra fields forbidden)
home_connect.context: The address (http only on the home network; https verifies with the provider TLS context) and the pasted long-lived access token (home_assistant_token format check)
home_connect.effects: GET /api/ (must answer API running.), GET /api/states, POST /api/template (areas) and GET /api/config; on success the token goes to the internal encrypted secret home_assistant_token and the address to home_assistant.url (an old home_assistant.token setting is dropped); home_status and settings to the owner's renderers
home_connect.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible
home_connect.response: Origin ACK {home}; invalid_token (401/403), unreachable, timeout, tls, not_home_assistant and format errors as fixed plain messages; the token is never echoed or logged
home_connect.lifetime: Up to four bounded requests (10 s each, redirects off)

home_disconnect.context: The stored token and the in-memory device list
home_disconnect.effects: Deletes home_assistant_token and the device list; keeps the address and access overrides; drops an old home_assistant.token setting. No network
home_disconnect.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible
home_disconnect.response: Origin ACK {home}; home_status to the owner's renderers

home_devices.context: The connected Home Assistant; refused with home_not_connected otherwise
home_devices.effects: GET /api/states, POST /api/template (rooms from areas; grouped by domain when it fails) and GET /api/config; refreshes the in-memory list
home_devices.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible
home_devices.response: Origin ACK {devices, rooms, grouped_by, home}; each device {entity_id, name, domain, room, state, state_text, available, access, toggle, on, dimmable, brightness, climate}

home_set_access.schema: HomeAccessRequest (entity_id, access can|ask|off; extra fields forbidden)
home_set_access.context: home_assistant.access overrides; an included domain only
home_set_access.effects: Persist the owner's choice through SettingsService (a choice equal to the default removes the override); settings snapshot to the owner's renderers. No network
home_set_access.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible; the only way a device becomes off limits

home_control_direct.schema: HomeControl (entity_id, action, value?; extra fields forbidden)
home_control_direct.context: The owner's own tile controls in Home, any access level
home_control_direct.effects: GET the entity, POST one /api/services call from the fixed action table, GET it again

home_control_direct.response: Origin ACK {device}; failures as fixed plain messages

proactive_unmute.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible; titles and bodies never logged
proactive_unmute.response: Origin ACK {ok: true}; not_found when the rule is gone; invalid_arguments as a plain message

proactive_mutes.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible; titles and bodies never logged
proactive_mutes.response: Origin ACK {ok: true, mutes: [{id, kind, source, person_id, created_at}]} oldest first

proactive_focus.effects: In memory only: decides in-app card versus overlay or balloon delivery; a newly focused workspace may release the digest

proactive_focus.response: Origin ACK {ok: true}; invalid_arguments as a plain message

mcp_servers_list.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible
mcp_servers_list.response: Origin ACK {servers}; env secrets appear only as {secret: name}, never as values

mcp_server_save.effects: Add or replace one server through SettingsService; a changed command, folder, env or timeout, or turning it off, stops its process and removes its tools; a name or policy change re-registers its tools; mcp_status to the owner's renderers
mcp_server_save.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible
mcp_server_save.response: Origin ACK {server}; invalid_arguments without pydantic details (they can include env values)
mcp_server_save.lifetime: Synchronous settings save plus a bounded process stop

mcp_server_remove.effects: Stop the server (close stdin, wait, kill its job tree), remove its tools and its settings entry; mcp_status to the owner's renderers
mcp_server_remove.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible
mcp_server_remove.lifetime: Synchronous settings save plus a bounded process stop

mcp_server_test.context: One configured server, enabled or not; secrets resolved by name from the encrypted SecretStore
mcp_server_test.effects: Start the server fresh (stdio, no shell, kill-on-close job), initialize, list its tools and report; an enabled server keeps running with its tools registered for the brain, a disabled one stops again; clears the restart backoff
mcp_server_test.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible
mcp_server_test.response: Origin ACK {test: {protocol_version, server_info, tools, elapsed_ms}}; failures as {code, message, exit_code, stderr} with secret values redacted
mcp_server_test.lifetime: Server start and initialize within timeout_s, then the paginated tools/list

mcp_tool_policy_set.effects: Persist one tool's policy through SettingsService and re-register the server's tools (deny removes the tool from the brain); mcp_status to the owner's renderers
mcp_tool_policy_set.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible

calls_list.context: Protected phone call records (CallRecords, DPAPI, 7-day retention) and calls.* settings
calls_list.effects: Read phone call records newest first as summaries {id, direction, mode, counterpart_masked, name, started_at, duration_seconds, urgency, needs_owner, summary, status, outcome_status}; needs_you = triage needs_owner or urgent, a missed incoming call, or a blocked/failed callback, and not marked done
calls_list.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible
calls_list.response: Origin ACK {ok, calls}; Origin ACK; masked phone numbers only; pydantic details and secret values are never echoed

calls_get.context: Protected phone call records (CallRecords, DPAPI, 7-day retention) and calls.* settings

calls_get.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible
calls_get.response: Origin ACK {ok, call}; not_found for an unknown or expired id; Origin ACK; masked phone numbers only; pydantic details and secret values are never echoed

calls_mark_done.context: Protected phone call records (CallRecords, DPAPI, 7-day retention) and calls.* settings
calls_mark_done.effects: Mark one record done (it leaves Needs you); the record is otherwise unchanged
calls_mark_done.policy: Independent owner/role/unlock gate; not a dispatcher tool and not model-visible
calls_mark_done.response: Origin ACK {ok}; not_found for an unknown id

calls_delete.context: Protected phone call records (CallRecords, DPAPI, 7-day retention) and calls.* settings

/telephony/voice/inbound.authentication: Separate 127.0.0.1 gateway (default port 8790, never the core port) reached only through the Cloudflare named tunnel; X-Twilio-Signature (HMAC-SHA1 with the Twilio Auth Token) over calls.public_base_url + exact path and query + sorted form params, constant-time; AccountSid must match; 403 otherwise
/telephony/voice/inbound.effects: Loop guard first (JARVIS's own number or withheld caller forwarded from the owner -> <Reject/> and internal owner_unreachable event); kill switch / no call agent -> voicemail or hang up per calls.when_disabled; otherwise <Connect><Stream> with a 2-minute single-use stream token bound to the CallSid

/telephony/voice/outbound.authentication: Separate 127.0.0.1 gateway (default port 8790, never the core port) reached only through the Cloudflare named tunnel; X-Twilio-Signature (HMAC-SHA1 with the Twilio Auth Token) over calls.public_base_url + exact path and query + sorted form params, constant-time; AccountSid must match; 403 otherwise; plus a single-use 2-minute ticket in the query bound to JARVIS's own outbound call record (To/From/CallSid rechecked)
/telephony/voice/outbound.effects: <Connect><Stream> for a call JARVIS placed (owner, or a third party under a consumed one-use grant); hang up when calls are off

/telephony/status.authentication: Separate 127.0.0.1 gateway (default port 8790, never the core port) reached only through the Cloudflare named tunnel; X-Twilio-Signature (HMAC-SHA1 with the Twilio Auth Token) over calls.public_base_url + exact path and query + sorted form params, constant-time; AccountSid must match; 403 otherwise
/telephony/status.effects: Record call status for JARVIS's outbound calls and emit an internal telephony.call_status event; 204

/telephony/media.authentication: Upgrade X-Twilio-Signature over the public wss:// (or https://) stream URL with no params, else HTTP 403; start message must carry the configured AccountSid and redeem the single-use stream token for its CallSid and direction
/telephony/media.effects: Bidirectional Twilio Media Stream (mu-law 8 kHz) bridged to CallAudioSession for the call agent; ends the call when the agent hangs up

verify_pin.mode: owner_briefing, morning_briefing (P2) and owner_alert (S7.2), only when the briefing PIN (call_briefing_pin) is set

verify_pin.policy: The PIN is never in the instruction, logs or record (spoken digits are redacted from captions); the call details reach the model only after a match; three failures end the call
